import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_13/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold transformed DataFrames from each source
dfs = []

for file_path in source_files:
    # Read source CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Extract only the columns needed for the target schema
    # Target schema: ['sex': string, 'smoker': string, 'tip_pct': float]
    # Source schema includes these columns, so just select them
    df_selected = df[['sex', 'smoker', 'tip_pct']].copy()
    
    # Ensure correct data types as per target schema
    df_selected['sex'] = df_selected['sex'].astype(str)
    df_selected['smoker'] = df_selected['smoker'].astype(str)
    df_selected['tip_pct'] = df_selected['tip_pct'].astype(float)
    
    dfs.append(df_selected)

# Since there is only one source table, no union needed beyond this
# If there were multiple sources with the same schema, we would concat here

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (only one here, but code is generic)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_13/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
